verdict.rationale: Linear's agent docs say agent session state on a delegated issue is visible to users and updates automatically from the agent's emitted activities, which gives some live status for in-progress work. That evidence covers only agent-delegated issues, and nothing documents general in-progress status views, blocker relationships, or last-update timestamps. Missing for 10: documented views of real-time status across all in-progress issues, what each task is blocked on, a last-update indicator, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch the real-time status of each in-progress task, including what it's blocked on and its last update

citations.quote: Session state is visible to users, and updated automatically based on the agent’s emitted activities.
Assigning an issue to your app now sets it as the `delegate`, not the `assignee`—so humans maintain ownership while agents act on their behalf.
